_doc: Reviewed access overlay applied to the OSM extract before tiling (scripts/apply_overlay.py). A rule adds tags to ways whose name/ref matches (optionally limited to a per-rule 'highways' list and a 'bbox' [west,south,east,north]); it never overrides a tag already on the way. Statuses applied by default: confirmed, user-approved-2026-11-19. 'assumed' rules are documented in PRD 12.3 s9 and are not in this file. motorway ways are already closed to bicycle/pedestrian by Valhalla defaults, so approved-by-general-rule expressways add motorcycle=no only. Upstream OSM should get the same tags.
